answer: Witnessed Uptime Ledger: agents earn identity weight by continuously answering randomized, context-bound challenges over weeks, countersigned by five peers who each risk their own weight. New agents enter through a nebula of low-trust lanes with capped throughput. Peers caught colluding lose accumulated weight, deepening the canyon between honest and fake networks. To spawn a convincing identity, an attacker must sustain real compute and peer attention for weeks, with umber reserve of patience; mass fabrication costs time, coordination, and reputational ruin, not money.
